Wire realtime_event durable dispatch + Fetch-SSE HTTP endpoints (/tickets, /snapshot, /resume) and the resume_stream resume into a controller is a later API task (TASK-0025 Chat/Generation/History API); acceptance is met at the persistence/contract layer
A finalize-via-append path would let chat.completed carry the correct stream_epoch/event_seq instead of the V7 DEFAULT; out of scope (V7 is frozen)
knownRisks: V7's finalize_generation still INSERTs chat.completed directly (event_seq=0, stream_epoch=1 DEFAULT); V8 cannot modify V7. Snapshot ordering now uses committed_at so seq=0 no longer inverts order, and the envelope still exposes committedAt for client ordering. A reset-then-finalize edge would misreport chat.completed streamEpoch (P2-2, accepted; normal Alpha flow does not reset before finalize).

append_realtime_event allocates next_seq via read-then-INSERT+UPDATE; concurrent appends are caught by realtime_event_seq_uniq (one raises unique_violation, app retries). Safe for one-stream-per-generation Alpha; an atomic UPDATE...RETURNING would remove the retry (P2-3, accepted).

advance_realtime_seq / expire_realtime_window model the non-durable delta high-water mark and the recoverable-window low-water mark durably; the actual in-memory delta buffer + window-advance scheduling is a later runtime task. The contract boundary (retained_after_seq) is what resume consults.
Java CI on main should pass (persistence compiles under Temurin 25, 39 tests green); confirm on next remote CI run.
